title: Container cannot resolve DNS behind corporate VPN
problem: Containers cannot resolve external hostnames while connected to the corporate VPN. Error: Temporary failure in name resolution.
resolution: Set explicit DNS servers for the daemon in daemon.json with the dns key, for example 8.8.8.8, then restart the Docker daemon. Verify with `docker run busybox nslookup google.com`.

title: Docker Desktop: Hardware assisted virtualization not enabled
problem: Docker Desktop shows the error Hardware assisted virtualization and data execution protection must be enabled in the BIOS.
resolution: Enable virtualization (Intel VT-x or AMD-V) in the BIOS or UEFI settings. Then run `bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype auto` and reboot the machine.

title: Bind mount shows empty folder on Windows
problem: A bind mount from a Windows folder shows an empty directory inside the container.
resolution: Make sure the drive is shared in Docker Desktop file sharing settings and store project files inside the WSL filesystem for better performance. Restart Docker Desktop after changing file sharing.
